sloka: ततः स पुर्याः सहसा महौजा निष्क्रम्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम्।बभक्ष रक्षो युधि कुम्भकर्णः प्रजा युगान्ताग्निरिव प्रदीप्तः ।। ६.६७.९४ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa puryāḥ sahasā mahaujā niṣkramya tadvānarasainyamugram।babhakṣa rakṣo yudhi kumbhakarṇaḥ prajā yugāntāgniriva pradīptaḥ ।। 6.67.94 ।।

translations.english: Himself (Sugriva) gone, the enemy of the Lord of gods rushed again retreating, "I am ferocious, without weapon." Then seizing an iron mallet, Sugriva went reflecting.
